title: Multi-Omics Integration Identifiesas a Candidate Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarker for Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Suggests Its Immunoregulatory Role.
snippet: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has an insidious onset and poor prognosis, and the limited diagnostic accuracy of alpha-fetoprotein necessitates novel biomarkers. title: The Histaminergic System: A Key Regulator of Pathogenesis and an Emerging Therapeutic Target in Autism Spectrum Disorder.
